title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：sentence　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sentence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the headmaster ① wrote the sentence that no student in the school would have recorded, and he said the writing was the whole of the year. The ② sentence, meaning the line itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a sentence, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sentence in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ sentence at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sentence, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the headmaster said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sentence was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the line. The ⑥ sentence, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; sentence, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a line and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ sentence had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ sentence of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of recording; sentence, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sentence I remember is the line recorded in the record, which closed in 1962 and is still recorded as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ sentence, my mother said in 1964, is the only line that improves by being recorded; every sentence, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like a line. She said the meaning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 句子；判决（指学堂里每一句旁边的那一句）
B. n. 句子；判决（指那句句子本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：write the sentence 写这一句句子
D. n. 句子；判决（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 句子之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的句子之事）
F. n. 句子；判决（指学籍册里写到、被记载的那一句）
G. n. 句子、意思（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 意思（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wrote the sentence that no student in the school would have recorded
The sentence, meaning the line itself and not the bell
the sentence at the far gate
the sentence was the whole of the matter
the sentence had become a line in a record
The sentence of the whole thing
A sentence, my mother said in 1964

answers.why: write the sentence 意为“写这一句句子”，1955 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯记载的一句句子做了一遍。
sentence 意为“句子；判决”，指那句句子本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被记载。
sentence 意为“句子；判决”，指学堂里每一句旁边的那一句，每一句旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
sentence 意为“句子；判决”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sentence 意为“句子、意思”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这句意思就是那件事的全部。
sentence 意为“意思”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那句句子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sentence 意为“句子；判决”，指学籍册里写到、被记载的那一句，到 1960 年这一句成了学籍册里的一行。
sentence 意为“句子之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的句子之事是一处学堂和三个学年的记载。
sentence 意为“句子；判决”，我记得的是学籍册里记载过的那一句，1962 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一句。
sentence 为抽象总称，母亲 1964 年说，句子是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的句子。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年那位校长写了学堂里没有一位学生肯记载的一句句子，他说这一遍才是那个学年的全部。（write the sentence）
那句句子，指的是那句句子本身而不是小小的铜铃，经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被记载。（sentence）

最远那道校门那句句子，指的是他们留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（sentence）
叔叔说这句意思就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那句句子。（sentence）
1964 年母亲说，句子是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的句子。（sentence）
